name: How can I prevent black mold from growing on drywall?

mainEntity.name: How can I prevent black mold from growing on drywall?

acceptedAnswer.text: Preventing black mold on drywall primarily involves controlling moisture. Promptly address any water leaks, whether from plumbing, roofs, or windows. Maintain indoor humidity levels below 60% using dehumidifiers, especially in damp areas like bathrooms and basements. Ensure adequate ventilation in kitchens and bathrooms by using exhaust fans. Quickly dry any wet areas or spills within 24-48 hours. Proper insulation can also help prevent condensation on walls, which can contribute to mold growth.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prevent black mold on drywall by controlling moisture: fix leaks promptly, maintain low indoor humidity, use ventilation, and dry wet areas within 24-48 hours.
